description: Week of the Europe/Paris DST transition (2026-10-25, CEST→CET): range covers UTC+2 days before Sunday and UTC+1 days after. A manual all_day row after the transition (Tue 2026-11-03) plus busy periods in both offsets (Mon 2026-10-26 +01:00 cabinet morning, Tue 2026-11-03 +01:00 afternoon) and a DB busy crossing the morning grid (Thu 2026-10-29).
